title: U.S. Midterms Bring New Restrictions for Data Centers
excerpt: Voters across the U.S. approved multiple ballot measures to impose stricter regulations on data center development.
body_html:
Recent U.S. midterm elections could bring significant changes to the tech and artificial intelligence industries following a series of public votes on infrastructure development.

During the elections, voters considered 41 ballot measures specifically related to data centers. Out of these, the vast majority resulted in voters choosing to place stricter limitations on future data center development. Even in regions where data centers were not directly on the ballot, the facilities remained a notable point of discussion.

The outcomes reflect growing public scrutiny regarding the expansion of data infrastructure, which plays a critical role in supporting modern AI technologies.
